boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 99 is the Expert Level — the densest and longest puzzle in the 50–100 range at 138 seconds. A large yellow/orange cross-shaped block dominates the center, a purple/blue block fills the top-left corner, green blocks stack vertically on the right, pink/magenta blocks line the left, and red blocks fill the remaining gaps. Lock/key icons on at least four blocks force a specific clearing order. Extract edge blocks first, clear the green and pink masses to expose the cross, then route it out last.
landmarks: Block Out Level 99 is the Expert Level — the densest and longest puzzle in the 50–100 range at 138 seconds.

A large yellow/orange cross-shaped block dominates the center, a purple/blue block fills the top-left corner, green blocks stack vertically on the right, pink/magenta blocks line the left, and red blocks fill the remaining gaps.
Lock/key icons on at least four blocks force a specific clearing order.
Extract edge blocks first, clear the green and pink masses to expose the cross, then route it out last.

quickTips: This is a 138-second marathon — plan moves, do not rush or force.
Clear the green stack (right) and pink mass (left) before anything else — they expose the cross block's sides.
The 'Super Slow' badge at ~01:48 means you are behind pace — prioritize the sides.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the smallest edge blocks first: cyan (bottom-right, rightward), blue (top-left, upward), pink (left side, leftward) — each creates incremental room (02:19–02:09 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Begin clearing the green blocks stacked on the right side through the right-wall exit because they expose the cross block's right arm (02:09–01:59).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the pink/magenta blocks on the left side through the left-wall exit because they expose the cross block's left arm (01:59–01:48).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Unlock the key blocks to open the locked paths — the cross-shaped block's lock must be unlocked before it can move (01:48).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the large purple/blue corner block from the top-left through the top or left exit because it frees the cross block's upper arm (01:38–01:27).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Extract the red blocks from the remaining packed areas through the nearest exits (01:27–01:06).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Route the yellow/orange cross-shaped block through the widest available exit path — it needs clearance in all four directions (01:06–00:56).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Finish with the last small blocks after the cross piece has exited (00:46–00:25).

failurePoints: Trying to move the cross-shaped block before clearing all four of its arms — it extends up, down, left, and right, and cannot move until every direction is clear.
Falling behind pace and seeing the 'Super Slow' badge — if the green and pink masses are still present at 01:48, the cross block cannot exit in time.
